extracted.name: Creamy Cilantro Lime Dressing
extracted.description: Quick and easy, creamy cilantro-lime dressing is great on a green salad, taco salad, or even as a dipping sauce for chicken.
ingredient_lines: 0.33333334326744 bunch fresh cilantro, or to taste
1 fresh tomatillo, husk removed, or more to taste
0.5 jalapeno pepper, stemmed and seeded, or more to taste
1 (1 ounce) package dry ranch dressing mix (such as Hidden Valley Ranch®)
0.125 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Blend buttermilk, mayonnaise, cilantro, tomatillo, lime juice, jalapeno pepper, ranch dressing mix, garlic, and black pepper together in a blender until smooth. Refrigerate until flavors blend, at least 1 hour.
